analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price 1,053,000 vs SMA5 1,113,800 below, SMA20 1,231,600 below: short-term and mid-term trend diagnosed as weak.
· Significantly below SMA100 1,608,865 and SMA200 1,532,407: long-term trend strength weakened.
· 52-week position 21.4% + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 38.4 → 36.1 (entering oversold): downtrend continues, need to confirm rebound.
· MACD histogram -6177.9987 → -2267.3293 (improving): weak reversal signal still tentative.
· Bollinger Band current price position 1,053,000 (approaching lower band 956,216): band width at 44.72% is relatively wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support 808,000: based on Pivot S1 842,333.
· Swing resistance 1,060,000: resistance near previous low.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): confirmed low at 1,027,000, potential for rebound attempt.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.13 (normal): moderate confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and potential Higher Low pattern formation; entry decision after further indicator confirmation.
